a.lede: Days after Ukrainian military drones took down several Russian data centers, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy claimed that the campaign had hurt Russia's disinformation efforts. "It suddenly became a little easier to breathe on many social platforms," Zelenskyy said Monday. "There was less hate, less division, and fewer provocations." a.title: Russian bot farms are still trolling, even after Ukraine’s drone strikes on Yandex

b.lede: After Ukrainian long-range strike drones targeted Russian data centers, various Russian digital services and apps went down or faced severe disruption. There's even some suggestion that online bot activity may be down, but not by as much as initial reports claimed.
b.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russian data centers, disrupting Russian apps and services
